examples.english: I'll be frank with you: this report isn't good enough.
examples.traditional: 我同你坦白講，呢份報告做得唔夠好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 taan2 baak6 gong2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 m4 gau3 hou2

examples.english: You can be candid with me about what you think of this arrangement.
examples.traditional: 你可以坦白同我講，你對呢個安排有咩睇法。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 taan2 baak6 tung4 ngo5 gong2 nei5 deoi3 ne1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3

examples.english: I’ll be ingenuous with you: I don’t want to take this job anymore.
examples.traditional: 我坦白同你講，我唔想再接呢份工作。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 taan2 baak6 tung4 nei5 gong2 ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 zip3 ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3

examples.english: To be straightforward, I do not have much confidence in this arrangement.
examples.traditional: 坦白講，我對呢個安排冇乜信心。
examples.jyutping: taan2 baak6 gong2 ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 mou5 mat1 seon3 sam1

examples.english: To be direct, I don’t think this plan will work.
examples.traditional: 坦白講，我唔覺得呢個計劃可行。
examples.jyutping: taan2 baak6 gong2 ngo5 m4 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ho2 haang4
